title: Real Student Pilot Validity Case v1
description: Schema for 20-30 real-student dialogue-state cases used only to check taxonomy and rubric applicability. This pilot is not a main experiment, not a learning-outcome study, and not a new baseline condition.

pilot_case_id.description: Anonymous pilot case identifier used only within the real-student validity check. This is not a dialogue-state v3 main-experiment case id.

student_id_hash.description: Anonymous stable hash for the student. Do not store real name, school, phone number, account name, or other direct identifiers.

problem_id_hash.description: Anonymous stable hash for the problem or assignment context. Do not store private course or platform identifiers unless already anonymized.

problem_context_summary.description: Redacted summary of the problem context needed to judge the missing bridge. Avoid unnecessary full problem statements.

student_message.description: Current student message after redaction. Preserve the tutoring meaning while removing direct identifiers.

recent_dialogue_redacted.description: Recent dialogue context with all direct identifiers removed. Use an empty string only if no recent dialogue is available.

student_code_excerpt_redacted.description: Minimal code excerpt needed to judge the bridge, with names, file paths, accounts, comments, and identifiers redacted. Use an empty string if no code is needed or available.

coach_missing_bridge_family.description: Bridge-family label selected by the coach, preferably from the existing CP-MissingBridgeBench taxonomy.

coach_missing_bridge_instance.description: Natural-language description of the concrete missing bridge in this case.

coach_forbidden_content.description: Content that a tutor should not directly provide in this turn because it would complete the learner's current bridge.

expected_next_student_action.description: The next action the student should be able to take after an appropriate scaffold.

observed_next_turn_progress.description: Observed next-turn progress if available. This is a validity signal for rubric fit, not a learning-outcome measure.

privacy_review_status.description: Privacy review status. Only cases marked passed should enter annotation or reporting.
